fields.label: API key
fields.description: In Audienceful: Settings → API → Generate key. Use a separate Audienceful workspace for your Swell test environment.

fields.label: Sync customers
fields.description: New and updated customers become Audienceful contacts, tagged swell-customer, with their name, address, order count and total spent. Customers who opted in to marketing are also tagged marketing-consent. Customers who withdraw consent are unsubscribed.

fields.label: Include customers who didn't opt in
fields.description: Off: only customers who agreed to receive marketing emails are synced. On: every customer with an email is synced and subscribed in Audienceful. Check that you're allowed to email them (in the EU, marketing emails usually need consent), and use the marketing-consent tag to send newsletters only to customers who opted in. Applies to orders and abandoned carts too.

fields.label: Send orders
fields.description: When an order is placed, the customer is tagged swell-buyer, their totals are updated, and the order event below starts your post-purchase automations.

fields.label: Order event
fields.description: The custom event to fire, created in Audienceful under Settings → Events. Properties: order_number, order_total, order_subtotal, discount_total, shipping_total, tax_total, currency, item_count, items, first_item_name.

fields.label: Send abandoned carts
fields.description: When Swell marks a cart abandoned (3 hours without activity) and the shopper's email is known, the cart event below starts your cart recovery automations. Turn off Swell's own abandoned cart emails under Settings → Notifications, so shoppers don't get two reminders.

fields.label: Abandoned cart event
fields.description: The custom event to fire, created in Audienceful under Settings → Events. Properties: checkout_url (link back to the cart), cart_total, cart_subtotal, discount_total, currency, item_count, items, first_item_name.
